Definition: from G2751; a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin:--money.
BiblicalUsage: Kerma means a small coin, a clipping. John 2:15 says Jesus poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe small coins in God's house can still be a big offence when the house becomes a market.
